text:
Lauren's annual salary is $100,000.
Annual savings = 20% of $100,000 = $20,000 per year.
Annual retirement expenses = 40% of $100,000 = $40,000 per year.
Total money needed for a 20-year retirement = 20 years × $40,000/year = $800,000.
Years she needs to work = $800,000 / $20,000/year = 40 years.

ANSWER: 40
